_comment: Per-project services the status collector HTTP-probes to decide FE/BE state (🟢 serving / 🟠 bound-but-erroring / 🔴 down). Keyed by the project name in the daemon registry. Each service is {port, health-path, url, repo}; a bare int also works (path defaults to /, no URL). `url` is the public preview URL the tunnel maps to that port and `repo` names the agents.env repo whose branch is being served there — status reports the two together, because a URL without the branch behind it can't tell you what you are looking at. Port numbers are single-sourced from projects/PORTS.md — keep them in sync when you add or move a service.
